name: Reina
source:
Main heroine.

A miko blessed by the Goddess of Chaos, she is ordered to serve the new Demon Sovereign. 

She ends up having her breasts fondled, stripped naked and compelled to have sex with the newly installed Demon Sovereign (the player transported from modern Japan to her world).
